name: er-diagram
description: Mermaid ER diagram viewer; draws the JSON that mapping_markdown.export_json writes from model and mapping markdown

scripts.export: cd .. && uv run --with-requirements er-diagram/requirements.txt python -m mapping_markdown.export_json --config er-diagram/data-finder.config.json --out er-diagram/out/data.json
scripts.generate: npm run export --silent && node generate.mjs --config data-finder.config.json
